facts.text: Students participating in the Semester in LA (SiLA) immersion program must complete a prerequisite preparation course, MEDI 334, and enroll in 12 credits in fall or spring (or 6 in summer) while interning and taking industry coursework in Los Angeles.

sources.title: SiLA Coursework - Semester in LA - Columbia College Chicago
sources.quote: Passing MEDI 334 is required for participation in the SiLA program. Students who do not complete this course successfully will not be eligible to attend the semester in Los Angeles.
